changelog: Your medals and camp drills now stick with a soldier for good — a unit no longer loses its Veteran Corps / Shock & Awe bonus once it survives into the standing army, and everything stacks correctly when it ranks up. Battle UI cleaned up: earned medals show in their own row under the top bar, the leftover unit card no longer floats on the menu after a fight, and the enemy briefing shows once at the start instead of firing again on your first move. The hold-objective marker (ring plus flag) now shows through the fog so you never lose the point, and the Fire Swamp's hidden exit is placed somewhere new out in the far reaches each run instead of always the far corner. Drilling a Bannerman correctly shows +DEF, and a couple of stray 'you found something' / control-point toasts on battle exit are gone.
